title: Create the GitHub sign-in provider and the deploy role
description: The account has no GitHub OIDC provider. Create it and a deploy role trusted only for the main branch of AnthusAI/Humorus, able only to start the Amplify job.

comments.author: home
comments.text: Template merged to develop (PR #3): infra/github-deploy/github-deploy.yaml and README.md (apply commands, plain-English capability list). NOT applied; needs Ryan's go-ahead. cfn-lint clean. Creates the GitHub OIDC provider (skippable) and role humorus-github-deploy, trusted only for repo:AnthusAI/Humorus on refs/heads/main, allowed only amplify:StartJob/GetJob on that branch's jobs (app id narrows once the Amplify app exists). No CDK or bootstrap-role rights, following the Papyrus site pattern where Amplify's own service role does the deployment.
